## UI acceptance — required for every stage
- [ ] Desktop and mobile screenshots compared with approved references
- [ ] Every in-scope screen/state/action checked; no dead ends or hidden missing controls
- [ ] Five supported languages and Arabic RTL checked where applicable
- [ ] Every difference resolved or covered by explicit versioned Rex approval
- [ ] Immutable reference source retained; no baseline overwritten to hide drift
- [ ] Evidence map links reference → implementation → screenshot/test → outcome

## Engineering evidence
- Exact candidate SHA:
- Tests, CI, browser regression results:
- Auth/state/security/retry checks where applicable:
- Email/provider delivery evidence if relevant (redacted; no secrets):
- Known limitations / real blockers:

## Review and release
Green CI/reviews do not establish visual acceptance. Unapproved visual or interaction differences block acceptance. Rex owns stage acceptance, merges, and deployment authorization.
